issues.explanation: Chapter 56 repeats the climax already covered at the end of Chapter 55: Zhou Yu’s pursuit, the Guanyu/Huang Zhong/Wei Yan ambush, his anger-triggered wound rupture, fainting, and retreat by ship. This is a material accidental repetition across the handoff.
